gw_policy_ops.activity.busy: The history database is busy — try again in a minute.
gw_policy_ops.activity.nodb: There is no activity history yet — nothing to delete.
gw_policy_ops.activity.nosqlite: The server has no sqlite3 module — no activity history is kept, nothing to delete.
gw_policy_ops.activity.off: Keeping the activity history is off — the history is erased already, nothing to delete.
gw_policy_ops.confirm_duplicate: The name “{name}” is already used. Save anyway?
gw_policy_ops.confirm_role: The exit goes to a group of another role — confirm the move.
gw_policy_ops.drop_more: The group got new keys — delete it again: they will go with the group.
gw_policy_ops.gone: Already deleted elsewhere — reload the page.
gw_policy_ops.group_missing: Group “{name}” is missing from the request: groups are deleted with their own button — reload the page.
gw_policy_ops.group_new: A new group is created with “+ Group”, not by saving the settings of a group.
gw_policy_ops.group_target: “{field}”: there is no group “{value}” (or it is the group being deleted).
gw_policy_ops.groups_many: There are already {max} groups — no more are allowed.
gw_policy_ops.log.rev_later: The version of the exit settings after “{what}” was not counted now (the state is busy) — the next read counts it.
gw_policy_ops.log.tg_rebuild_failed: Telegram API proxy: the rebuild by group did not start ({rc}).
gw_policy_ops.main: The Main group can’t be deleted.
gw_policy_ops.metrics_bad: The history size is a whole number from {lo} to {hi} MB.
gw_policy_ops.moves_changed: While the question was open, the devices that change their path changed — nothing written. Look at what changes now and try again.
gw_policy_ops.need: Choose where to move the exits, the users and the other links to the group.
gw_policy_ops.no_country: The exit shows no new country — nothing to accept.
gw_policy_ops.object_changed: These settings were changed elsewhere — reload the page and try again.
gw_policy_ops.policy_changed: Exit settings were changed while you were editing — reload the page and try again.
gw_policy_ops.regroup_accepted: Request accepted: the collector will move the devices within a minute.
gw_policy_ops.regroup_frozen: The layout is frozen: the server is offline. You can regroup once it is back online.
gw_policy_ops.regroup_frozen_ru: The layout is frozen: the server cannot reach Russian addresses. You can regroup once they are reachable again.
gw_policy_ops.regroup_note: Open connections stay up; for the devices that move, sites will see another address — banks and mail may ask to sign in again.
gw_policy_ops.regroup_nothing: Nothing to regroup in a “per connection” group: each new connection picks its exit itself.
gw_policy_ops.regroup_off: The gateway is off — nothing to regroup.
gw_policy_ops.regroup_preview: About {n} device will move|About {n} devices will move
gw_policy_ops.regroup_preview_none: Every device is already on its own exit — nobody moves.
gw_policy_ops.rev_required: The panel has been updated — reload the page.
gw_policy_ops.ru_last: This is the last domestic group: move or delete its keys first.
gw_policy_ops.use_enabled: An exit is turned on and off with its own button — reload the page.
gw_policy_ops.use_move: An exit changed its group: exits are moved with “Move to group”, not by saving the settings of a group.
gw_policy_ops.ver_required: The panel has been updated — reload the page.
